AIF Knowledge chevron_right Cat III AIF chevron_right Long Short Market Neutral
Category III AIF

Long Short Market Neutral

Pure alpha extraction through rigorous stock selection, stripped of all directional market risk—delivering equity-linked returns with near-zero correlation to broader market indices.

Definition & Purpose

Long Short Market Neutral Funds under Category III AIF maintain portfolios with a net market exposure (beta) close to zero, balancing long positions in companies expected to outperform against short positions in companies expected to underperform within the same sector or risk factor group. Return generation is entirely driven by the spread between winning long and winning short positions—pure alpha divorced from market direction. These funds are most valuable in portfolio construction as genuine diversifiers that perform regardless of whether broad equity markets rise or fall.

Key Characteristics

commit

Beta-Hedged Portfolio Construction

Each long position is paired with a corresponding short position of equal or near-equal beta-adjusted value, ensuring the portfolio's sensitivity to broad market moves is minimized to a target range of -0.2 to +0.2. Factor exposure—size, value, momentum, quality—is also monitored and neutralized to ensure returns reflect only stock-specific alpha and not unintended systematic risk loadings.

compare_arrows

Pair Trading Architecture

The fundamental expression of market neutral investing is the pair trade—a simultaneous long and short in two highly correlated securities where the manager believes relative value will converge or diverge in their favor. Pairs are constructed within sectors or supply chains to minimize exogenous macro risk, with statistical and fundamental validation of the spread relationship before position initiation.

scatter_plot

Low Correlation to Other Assets

Because market neutral returns are driven by stock-specific alpha rather than market beta, realized correlation to equity indices, bond markets, and commodity prices is structurally low. This makes market neutral allocations uniquely effective portfolio diversifiers for institutional investors seeking to reduce overall portfolio volatility without sacrificing return potential through cash or fixed-income ballast.

The Market Neutral Fund Lifecycle

Phase 01

Idea Generation & Pair Selection

Investment ideas emerge from fundamental research screens identifying relative valuation discrepancies within peer groups, and from statistical analysis of historical price spread behavior. Pairs are validated for economic rationale, minimum historical correlation thresholds, and sufficient liquidity in both legs to enable frictionless position sizing and exit.

Phase 02

Risk-Controlled Execution

Positions are executed to achieve target beta neutrality at the portfolio level, verified through factor model attribution daily. Stop-loss rules are rigorously enforced on spread positions that move adversely, limiting the impact of any single pair thesis failure. Portfolio-level gross exposure is managed within SEBI-mandated AIF leverage limits.

Phase 03

Convergence & Harvest

Profits are realized when the fundamental mispricing converges—the long outperforms the short as the market recognizes the relative value gap. Positions are closed when thesis targets are achieved, when holding periods expire, or when catalyst risk makes continuation inadvisable. Continuous reinvestment of harvested alpha into new pairs sustains return generation through the fund's operating life.

Institutional Benchmarks

Alchemy Capital Management

Quantamental Market Neutral

Alchemy Capital combines quantitative factor screening with fundamental validation to construct market neutral books in Indian equities. Their investment process integrates earnings quality scoring, short-interest analytics, and sector-relative valuation to generate a continuously refreshed pipeline of pair trade candidates with high probability of spread convergence within defined time horizons.

360 ONE Asset Management

Diversified Alternatives Platform

360 ONE's alternatives platform manages market neutral strategies alongside its broader AIF lineup. Their market neutral vehicles apply systematic factor neutralization and rigorous risk management to generate equity-linked alpha with significantly lower drawdown characteristics than directional equity strategies. The platform's scale provides access to superior research infrastructure and derivative execution across the NSE and BSE.
